method_changes: Crexi: the public search API api.crexi.com/assets/search accepts {pageSize,page,includeUnpriced} plus types:['Retail'], states:['TX'] and counties:[...] — but pagination and sortBy are silently ignored for anonymous callers, so it only ever returns a fixed first 50 unsorted. Use the UI 'New Listings' sort instead and enrich harvested ids via api.crexi.com/assets/{id} (gives activatedOn, askingPrice, types, locations, thumbnailUrl). The Crexi tab freezes under long scroll loops — keep each javascript_tool call under ~30s.
Crexi: the DFW boundary is set by typing 'Dallas-Fort Worth' into the location box and picking 'Dallas Fort Worth Metropolitan Area, TX'.

Secure Net Lease: the card grid renders empty for automation, but GET /wp-json/api/v1/property returns all 53 listings with price, cap, NOI, SF, year, status, address and bg_url. The bg_url upload month is a good proxy for listing age.

Matthews: skip the infinite-scroll entirely — GET cms.matthews.com/wp-json/wp/v2/new-property?per_page=100&page=N&orderby=date&order=desc returns full ACF records (city, state, price, cap, SF, tenancy, status). Photo id resolves via /wp-json/wp/v2/media/{id}?_fields=source_url.

CBRE: /properties/properties-for-sale is gone. The working path is /properties/properties-for-lease/commercial-space?aspects=isSale, then type the city into the location box. Listings now have stable /details/US-SMPL-{id}/{slug} URLs.
Colliers: the hash facet does not apply on a cold load. Type the city into the LOCATION box and pick the 'Texas > {City}' suggestion; clear the box with ctrl+a before retyping or the text appends.

Marcus & Millichap: hash pageNumber changes do not re-render — click the pagination links. Sort is Most Recent by default but listing id is a better recency signal (310028 was newer than everything on page 1).
NAI Robert Lynn: POST action=properties_data to /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php still works, 739 markers. property_id is monotonic — anything above the previous run's max is new.
SHOP Companies: /properties.json?perPage=60&type=map-detail&broker=all&tags=all&sort=created&direction=desc&ne=false&sw=false&page=0 works; nid is monotonic by created date.
Output filter: javascript_tool results get blocked when they contain URL query strings or long hashes. Return plain-text lines with paths stripped, and never echo full image URLs.
run_notes.environment_note: The Linux sandbox could not mount the outputs folder on this run (Windows update of 2026-09-08). Files were written with the file tools and uploaded to GitHub by building them in-page with javascript_tool rather than gzip+base64 via bash.

note: Run of 2026-09-14. 28 new listings added. Crexi now serves search from POST https://api.crexi.com/assets/search (requires includeUnpriced; geography/sort params are ignored) and per-asset detail from https://api.crexi.com/assets/{id} with an activatedOn field -- so the reliable path is the DFW-boundary + 'New Listings' sort in the web UI, harvesting /properties/{id} hrefs from the virtualized list (mouse-wheel scroll only) then enriching via the assets API. Crexi thumbnails: https://crexi.com/images/format=auto,width=716,height=444,fit=cover/assets/{id}/{hash}.{ext}.
